resources.string: Keeps the Liquid Glass notification droplet synchronized with the selfie camera.
Live system notification previews for testing the selfie-camera droplet.
Tap a droplet preset or send a real OS alert to watch the meniscus detach from your selfie lens.
Connect Android Notification Listener and Overlay Window to replace heads-up popups below your selfie camera.
1. Enable Notification Access & Display Over Apps above so DropGlass intercepts incoming alerts in real time.
2. To hide ColorOS\'s duplicate stock banner, open Settings → Notifications & Status Bar → App notifications and turn off Banner for apps you want in Liquid Glass.
3. In Battery → App management, set DropGlass to Allow background activity & Auto-launch so ColorOS keeps the lens meniscus alive.
